# Mangalam Healthy Foods

> Mangalam Healthy Foods (mahealthyfoods.in) makes Amutham Sprouted Health Mix — a 100% natural porridge powder from 9 soak-sprouted ancient grains and millets plus Mappillai Samba rice, stone-ground in Sethiyathope, Tamil Nadu. No chemicals, preservatives, or refined sugar. FSSAI 12423028000746.

## Shop

- [All products](https://mahealthyfoods.in/products): sprouted health mixes, heirloom rice, cold-pressed oils, organic sweeteners (₹110+).
- [Amutham Sprouted Health Mix](https://mahealthyfoods.in/products): signature 9-grain sprouted mix, from ₹110.

## Why sprouted

- [The science](https://mahealthyfoods.in/why-sprouted): soak-sprouting degrades phytic acid, unlocking up to 3x Iron, Calcium, and Zinc absorption; pre-digested starches for lighter digestion.
